answer: The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, idle agents bleed standing. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. By the raven of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The haven holds work receipts rather than names, so the zenith of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
